title: WARNING: Hidden costs, degrading algos, and zero refunds with "The Golden Suite" / Next Gen / xxxxclub
author: luuckyguyymmaatrade
selftext:
I’m posting this to save fellow traders from wasting their money. I have 6 years of manual and algo trading experience, and I recently spent over £1,140 with this group (initial £873 + hidden mandatory costs). Here is the reality of what you are actually buying:

The "Bespoke" Lie: It is not a custom algorithm. It is a single, generic TradingView indicator shared with hundreds of users. "Customization" is literally just them tweaking row numbers for you.

Hidden Mandatory Costs: The £800+ entry fee is a trap. You are forced to pay for TradingView Plus (£42/mo), a VPS (£25/mo), and a trade copier if you aren't on MT4. The monthly fee also jumps to £147 after month one.

Fake Backtests: Their backtests deliberately ignore spread, slippage, and commission. To hit their promised 70% win rate, you have to set TP smaller than SL. This looks great on a cost-free backtest but bleeds money in live markets.

Zero Live Performance: Following their exact support instructions for AUDNZD and EURJPY, my demo account executed zero trades in two weeks. Not a single trade on My £200 prop firm challenge.

No Refunds: When I pointed out the product didn't work as advertised, I was blamed, and my refund was flatly denied.

They operate under multiple names (The Golden Suite, Next Gen, xxxxclub). If you value your capital, look elsewhere. I have receipts and chat logs if anyone wants to see the technical breakdown of how this setup fails in live conditions.
